notes: Target Home (target.com), scoped strictly to the site's own 'Pets' department (https://www.target.com/c/pets/-/N-5xt44), a same-level sibling of Home & Decor/Kitchen & Dining/etc. in Target's root taxonomy. ACCESS: direct HTTP fetch (curl, plain UA) reached every /c/ category page cleanly (200) and the server-rendered __NEXT_DATA__ script on each page exposes the site's own taxonomy.metadata.children array (node_id, name, number_of_children, canonical_url) - this is the authoritative category tree, walked breadth-first from the Pets root through Dog Supplies (17 children) and Cat Supplies (16 children); every node with number_of_children=0 was spot-checked by fetching it directly and confirming it has no further real children (only brand-page or duplicate-parent cross-links). QTY METHOD: category PLP grids are client-rendered so counts are not in the raw HTML. First tried Target's redsky_aggregations/v1/web/plp_search_v2 -> search_response.metadata.total_results endpoint via WebFetch (direct curl_cffi/Playwright requests to redsky all got 403/435 PerimeterX blocks from this IP, matching the prior Home-Decor pass's note) using the prior pass's exact verified param set (default_purchasability_filter=true, include_sponsored=false, include_dmc_dmr=true - confirmed this combo gives the non-inflated true count by testing default_purchasability_filter=false/true and include_sponsored=false/true side by side on two nodes). Got 12 of 13 Dog Supplies leaf counts this way before WebFetch itself started getting 403'd from redsky (rate-based PerimeterX block) - per the brief's 'first block stops that host' rule, stopped calling redsky entirely once blocked (also independently confirmed blocked via Playwright network-interception of the site's own client-side XHR call, which returned a PerimeterX captcha page). For the one remaining Dog Supplies row (Dog Clothing & Accessories) and all Cat Supplies (12) and Pets-root-only (4) leaves, escalated to Claude-in-Chrome (robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow) and read the rendered 'N results' header directly on each live PLP page - this is the same number the grid paginates through. Dog Clothing & Accessories showing exactly '2,463 results' (identical to Dog Collars/Harnesses/Leashes' redsky count) looked like possible stale/cached data at first, so it was independently re-navigated and re-checked from scratch - confirmed twice, genuine coincidence not a caching artifact. EXCLUDED as navigation/marketing, not categories: Pet Deals, Gifts for Pets, Pets New Arrivals, New Dog Checklist, New Cat Checklist (curated 'what a new pet needs' landing pages, each with exactly one child that just links back to Puppy/Kitten Supplies). EXCLUDED as brand landing page: Boots & Barkley (/b/ URL, Target's pet private label brand hub - appears as a pseudo-child on almost every Pets node). OVERLAP: Puppy Supplies and Kitten Supplies are each cross-listed both directly under the Pets root AND under Dog Supplies / Cat Supplies respectively (identical node_id/canonical_url in both places) - recorded once each, nested under Dog Supplies / Cat Supplies since that is their more specific home; not double-counted. Pet Health & Wellness (node 5xt3j) has a URL slug 'dog-health-wellness' but its own page title/H1 and breadcrumb read 'Pet Health & Wellness' (covers both dog and cat) - kept as one row under the Pets root, not nested under Dog Supplies. No zero-result Pet Care nodes were found (none dropped for that reason) - all leaf counts above 0.
